messages.subject: Unable to deploy package dependency 'uroot'
parts:
I got the following message


> library(shinyapps)
> deployApp(appName="smoothing")
Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://hhkao.shinyapps.io/smoothing? [Y/n] Y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...
Error: 
* Unable to deploy package dependency 'uroot'
   
   The package was installed locally from source. Only packages installed
   from CRAN or GitHub are supported.


But there is no "uroot" package for R 3.1.0

> install.packages("uroot")
Warning in install.packages :
  package root?is not available (for R version 3.1.0)
